Copilot fallback bug is reproducible: open /copilot and wait >5s — iframe stays blank, [data-testid=copilot-embed-fallback] is never inserted into the DOM.
rca of the issue: MicrosoftCopilot.jsx lines 88-93: useEffect schedules `setTimeout(()=>{ if (!iframeLoaded) setEmbedFailed(true); }, 4000)`. The iframe's onLoad handler (line 261) sets iframeLoaded=true. In Chromium, an `<iframe src=https://copilot.microsoft.com/>` that gets X-Frame-Options: DENY still emits a `load` event (about a blank document), so iframeLoaded flips to true within ~200 ms and the 4 s probe finds !iframeLoaded === false → embedFailed is never set → the fallback DOM is never rendered. Fix: either drop the iframeLoaded check entirely from the timeout (always set embedFailed=true after 4 s and let onLoad clear it via a postMessage handshake), or use `iframe.contentWindow.document.readyState` inside a try/catch (SecurityError on a cross-origin iframe is the actual signal that the embed succeeded, not a load event).
